builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-18, for the boys basketball build: name-by-name web searches for every 2025-26 varsity junior and sophomore (grades 11 and 10) on MaxPreps' 2025-26 roster pages and stat sheets for the 41 registry teams, school-by-school signing-day and recruiting searches, Prep Hoops, Cal-Hi Sports and On3 class lists and offer pages, NCSA and SportsRecruits searches, and school and local papers.
notes: Players on the 2025-26 varsity teams who were juniors (class of 2027) or sophomores (class of 2028) that season, and whom a public page says have committed to, or signed with, a college team, in basketball or any other sport. The rules are data/commits.json's (README, "College commitments"). Last season's seniors are out of scope. The research record of 2026-11-18: it holds no commitment, so nothing was copied into data/basketball/commits.json, the file the pages read.

No commitment was found: none of the 216 juniors, 64 sophomores and 7 ungraded Gunn rows had a page naming a college commitment that meets the rule. Near misses were game stories, all-league lists and same-name players elsewhere.

Recall is partial. Every row got at least one name search, but most of these players have no web presence beyond MaxPreps; Prep Hoops' and Cal-Hi Sports' 2027 and 2028 lists are behind a paywall; and the community colleges' athletics sites (PrestoSports) refused every read.
